title: Fan-in: merge channels
prompt:
Write `Merge[T any](chans ...<-chan T) <-chan T`.

- Forward every value from every input to the output, reading all inputs at the same time.
- Keep each input's own order; interleaving between inputs can be anything.
- Close the output once all inputs are closed and drained. No inputs → an already-closed output.

`Merge(gen(1, 2), gen(10))` → `1 2 10` in some interleaving, then closed.
hint: One forwarding goroutine per input plus a `WaitGroup`; a separate goroutine waits and closes the output.
